Market today: Treasury yields are climbing fast, signaling rate hike bets are back on. This is the main driver for your tech/chip heavy book, especially the leveraged names.

Your holdings: SOXL (-34.93%) and SPAL (-34.04%) are flagged for attention. As you know, margin amplifies these drops, so watch them closely.

Watch: Rising Treasury yields and any news that could impact chip demand or interest rate sensitivity.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and the rising yield environment.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or stopping out if it breaks below its current price, given the leveraged decay and negative PnL.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate stopping out if the price continues to fall, to protect against further margin calls.
AAPL: Scanner shows a BUY setup (entry 336.19-335.86, stop 334.96). Consider if this aligns with your risk tolerance and market view.
